metric_id.0: raw inner product; native lower-is-better negative IP

commands.qualification: bin/benchmark qualification config.json (n<=256, timing_repeats=1, any subset of K_L, formal_performance=false)

common_native_config.note: total_n and row_start are optional; full file container size always checked, n is consumed prefix/window. Base/index check is sampled full words; wrapper binds full immutable source SHA.

source_semantics.global_ids: sorted unique targets from all TRAIN omission tokens
source_semantics.hub_targets: per hub sorted unique targets from all TRAIN omission tokens associated with that routed hub, no capacity truncation
source_semantics.hub_offsets: H+1 offsets into hub_targets, hub order matches ids
source_semantics.token_queries: local consumed TRAIN row index, aligned one-to-one to token_targets

benchmark_outputs: output_dir/k<K>/<method>_L<L>/raw/{ids.i32,distances.f32,entry_ids.i32,profile_distances.f32}; result.json; common complete.json includes results list

round_schema.packet_sha256: SHA256 over shape then six complete vectors; no hash inside wall

timing: All 3 rounds include normal Batch allocation/init, all routing, original scalar main search, residual scoring/merge, uniform full six-vector packet copy to preallocated archive, and actual normal Batch destruction. Warmup256 separate. Later rounds are compared bit-for-bit and hashed against actual retained round0; no extra ANN replay.
oracles: All POST final returns independently reconstructed using same K/L/router measured GT baseline, fresh scalar scores and linear topK replacement; baseline score words verified. No separate per-POST pre-main packet retained.
